topic: Factors Affecting Object Movement and Position
key_concepts: Objects that change position encounter a push or a pull.
People can move objects by pushing, pulling, carrying, lifting, or blowing.
Wind and water can make objects move.
The size and shape of an object affect how it falls.
Surface texture is how something feels when touched and can be smooth or rough.
Surface texture affects how an object moves down a ramp.
Heaviness means how much something weighs.
Heavy objects need a strong force to move, while lighter objects need less force.
The heaviness of an object affects its movement down a ramp.

Objects can move closer, farther, left, or right in relation to their original position.
